Purpose and scope
Integrate the three workstreams on the supplied dirty baseline, resolving shared catalog/profile/migration changes deliberately. Run the full standard PostgreSQL runner including ordinary tests and recovery, relevant upstream checks when bids4s changed, temporal numerical qualification, the publication demo and the phase-family corpus. Update existing documentation from observed results.

Acceptance proof
All required checks pass with exact commands, fresh logs/artifact paths, source fingerprints and accurate test counts. Backup/restore retains publication outputs and current policy. Historical interpretation IDs still decode; current disclosure/revocation rules hold. README, scientific-core and implementation-plan describe actual coverage and limitations. Close children only with their evidence, then close the epic.

Start here
scripts/check-postgres.sh; scripts/check-temporal-statistics.py; README.md; docs/{implementation-plan,scientific-core,decisions-and-evidence}.md

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: G1: Verify the complete night tranche and refresh executable evidence
